attributes.title: The Gulf Atlantic Veterinary Conference 2026
attributes.venue: Fort Lauderdale Marriott Harbor Beach Resort & Spa
attributes.summary:
The Gulf Atlantic Veterinary Conference is the Florida VMA's main small animal and exotics meeting, held December 3 to 5, 2026, at the Fort Lauderdale Marriott Harbor Beach Resort & Spa. Registration covers lectures, networking events and the exhibit hall; wet labs and hotel rooms are booked separately.

FVMA says the program is approved for CE in jurisdictions that recognize RACE, with hours reported to AAVSB RACEtrack. Each 50-minute lecture counts as one credit; veterinarians can earn up to 24 and veterinary technicians up to 16, chosen from about 188 hours of DVM content and 68 hours of technician content.

The group hotel rate of $299 per night applies to bookings made before November 11, 2026. Registration fees were not visible on the pages we checked.
